The schema examples: "Load cell", "Indicator", "Measuring system", "Fuel dispenser", "Taximeter", "Gas meter". Since it's an electronic calculating/indicating device, "Indicator" seems closest. Actually R117 has "measuring system", "fuel dispenser" components like calculators, converters, sensors. I'll use "Indicator" — hmm, "Calculator" might be better. Let me think: The pattern is "Electronic calculator and indicator model Masterload II". Category: "Calculator and indicator"? The schema says category is like "Load cell", "Indicator", "Measuring system", ... with ellipsis, so I can use "Calculator" or "Calculator and indicator". I'll use "Calculator".

Hmm, let me use "Indicator" since examples include Indicator. Actually "Electronic calculator and indicator" — I'll set category: "Calculator and indicator".

Type designations: "Masterload II". Also prime parts: BEMY106-XX (Electronic Display Unit), BEMY105-YY (PSU), BMMZ333ZZ (Pulse Transmitter), alternatives BEMY106A-XX, BEMY105A-YY, BMMZ333ZZA.
